newsitem.title: USA: Ivory Coast buys 26,516 T U.S. long grain rice.
newsitem.headline: Ivory Coast buys 26,516 T U.S. long grain rice.

text.p: Ivory Coast bought 26,516 tonnes U.S. No.2 long grain brown rice under PL 480, Title I program, its U.S. export agent said.

The first shipment of 18,000 tonnes was slated for the October 15-November 15. It included 6,000 tonnes from Louis Dreyfus at $355.24 a tonne, FOB, 6,000 tonnes from Louis Dreyfus at $359.89 and 6,000 tonnes from Connell Rice at $362.99, the agent said.
The second shipment of 8,516 tonnes was set for November 15-December 15. It included 6,000 tonnes from Louis Dreyfus at $356.74 a tonne and 2,516 tonnes from Louis Dreyfus at $363.39.
The rice was to be shipped in bulk.
